_comment: Hand-written (Keybinds -> Realm Selector, from Melinoe's realm lists, with permission). A region is picked by the region part of the Tab 'Server' value ('[<region>, <realm>]'): the first region whose 'prefix' starts it (case-insensitive). realms = normal realms, hubs = hub / mission servers (own row). Every button runs /joinq <name>.
